meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 后，Claude 显示真实 token 用量与节省估算（直接读会话日志，非 AI 估算），附带规则开销与净节省。数字由 hook 注入，模型本身不计算。
howto.when: 当用户在 Claude Code 中输入命令 /caveman-stats 时触发。

say.note: 立即显示当前会话的 token 用量和节省估算。

say.text: 用 /caveman-stats 看看这次会话花了多少 token
say.note: 输出真实日志数字，不含 AI 估算。

say.text: /caveman-stats 算一下规则开销划不划算
say.note: 净节省为负时会明确提示并建议关掉 caveman。

howto.what_en: Entering /caveman-stats shows real token usage and estimated savings for the session, read directly from the session log (not AI-estimated). It also shows estimated rule overhead and net savings. Numbers are injected by a hook; the model does not compute them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user runs the /caveman-stats command in Claude Code.

say_en.note: Immediately shows token usage and savings estimate for the current session.

say_en.text: Use /caveman-stats to see how many tokens this session used
say_en.note: Outputs real log numbers, no AI estimation.

say_en.text: /caveman-stats — see if the rule overhead is worth it
say_en.note: If net savings are negative, it says so and suggests turning caveman off.
